title: An unforgettable experience
text: If seeing the Alhambra is already a wonderful experience in itself, with the guide who accompanied us, it was something exceptional. The 3 hours she accompanied us felt very short. We were lucky to be a small group, so the visit was much more enriched. The guide, her name is Noelia, has knowledge, not only of the Alhambra but of culture and history in general, that makes the experience a delight and you keep it like another Nasrid treasure.
author: elJosele

title: Super visit to the Alhambra
text: Fantastic visit with the guide Miguel Ángel Avilés, very complete, very well documented. Magnificent exhibition supported by images and audiovisual reconstructions, extensive knowledge of botany and Arabic verses. We loved it. Highly recommended!!
